values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/milakokialake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Milakokia Lake State Forest Campground, Mackinac: 35 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat launch suited to kayaks, canoes and small watercraft.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/milakokialake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'There is a boat launch suitable for kayaks, canoes and small watercrafts.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/milakokialake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table (Milakokia Lake: 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: '35 sites for tent, small trailer and large trailer use' in two loops; sites 12-35 'are more suitable for large trailers' (no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/milakokialake ('There are 35 sites for tent, small trailer and large trailer use.'; 'Sites #12-35 are more suitable for large trailers.'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site.') + amenity table (35 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Lake Superior State Forest campground on the NE side of Milakokia Lake, in two loops: sites 1-11 to the right of the entrance, 12-35 to the left (the better choice for a larger rig). Managed by Tahquamenon Falls State Park. 20 mi W of Naubinway via US-2, East Milakokia Lake Road and Pike Lake Grade. --Claude

Season (open all year, roads may not be plowed) already manual and matches the table. Phone 906-293-5900 matches the page and the table (Tahquamenon Falls SP).
